summary: Added sdk/state (snapshot.py, __init__.py): a frozen AccountSnapshot with alias, tz-aware observed_at, source, game_version, hull level, trophies, resources, crew, rooms, research and inventory, plus per-section complete/partial/missing status. build_snapshot copies only whitelisted fields from already-parsed xmltodict responses, marks missing or unparseable data as unknown instead of inventing it, refuses e-mail or display-name aliases, and refuses copied values that sdk.redaction would redact. diff_snapshots refuses cross-account and reversed-time comparisons and lists sections missing on either side as unknown_sections. Added 17 synthetic tests and docs/baseline/account-snapshot.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Client stores raw parsed XML on the instance with no alias, timestamp or completeness
contract_status_changes.after: Typed AccountSnapshot and SnapshotDelta with account isolation, provenance, completeness and unknown-not-invented semantics

residual_risks: Attribute names (@ShipLevel, @Trophy, @ResearchState and others) come from existing client code and mocked tests, not from a current live capture.
Resources are passed in by the caller; no adapter from Client state to build_snapshot exists yet (planned for r1-reconciled-action-runner).
